The woman on the left wears a light blue sleeveless top and white ruffled shorts, while the woman on the right wears a black sleeveless top and matching white shorts. Both wave and smile warmly at the camera. (2) The two women cross their arms over their chests in a coordinated motion, looking expectantly at the lens. The background features a large sliding wardrobe with dark frames and a white dresser, suggesting a bedroom or dressing area environment. (3) As text prompts appear above them, the women respond by pointing their index fingers towards themselves or each other. Their movements are synchronized, and they maintain cheerful facial expressions with clear eye contact. The lighting is bright and even across the scene. (4) For the final question, both women point at each other simultaneously and then turn to face one another, laughing and shrugging their shoulders in a playful manner as the video ends. Their footwear consists of matching white slippers adorned with small red strawberry motifs.
